en_title: Mass Effect Leaks Reveal Canceled BioWare Game's Story Would Have Accounted for 'All' Choices From Previous Games
cn_title: 泄露称《质量效应》续作原计划承接所有选择
subtitle: 时间线任你改写
opus_summary: BioWare已取消的《质量效应》续作原计划纳入前三部作品中的所有选择，并据此构建不同时间线。前技术总监Romain Toutain称，相关系统已在实际运行中奏效，但项目最终随工作室关闭而取消。

paragraphs.en: Additional details about BioWare's canceled Mass Effect game have leaked online, revealing a story that would have taken choices from the Commander Shepard trilogy into account if EA hadn't shut down the studio.
paragraphs.cn: BioWare已取消的《质量效应》游戏又有更多细节泄露。若EA没有关闭工作室，这款游戏的剧情原本会考虑玩家在指挥官谢泼德三部曲中做出的选择。

paragraphs.en: The long-awaited and currently canned follow-up for the sci-fi RPG franchise, which was working under the title Mass Effect: Universe, was built around decisions made in the original games, according to comments shared by former technical director Romain Toutain during a recent livestream (via Kotaku ). As more details about the project leak, there's no telling exactly how thorough this system would have been, but he did his best to give fans an idea.
paragraphs.cn: 据前技术总监Romain Toutain近日在直播中的说法，这款备受期待、如今已被取消的科幻RPG系列续作，开发期间曾以《质量效应：宇宙》为名，并围绕初代游戏中的选择构建。Kotaku转述了这番发言。随着项目细节陆续泄露，目前还无法确定这套系统原本能覆盖多全面，但Toutain尽力向粉丝介绍了大致构想。

paragraphs.en: "All the choices made in the first Mass Effect games were taken into account," Toutain said (translation via Bluesky user @loustica-lucia.bsky.social ). "One of the reasons why it was called 'Mass Effect: Universe' is that you had so many choices. That you could plug your saves together to create parallel universes, to keep it simple. It's not exactly how it worked. You had different timelines, basically."
paragraphs.cn: Toutain说：「《质量效应》初代游戏中的所有选择都会纳入考量。」（译文来自Bluesky用户@loustica-lucia.bsky.social。）「之所以叫《质量效应：宇宙》，原因之一就是玩家能做出太多选择。简单来说，你可以把存档拼接起来，创造平行宇宙。不过实际运作方式并不完全如此，本质上是不同的时间线。」

paragraphs.en: Mass Effect fans know how crucial the series' overarching story is, especially when it comes to Commander Shepard's first three installments in his/her fight against the Reapers. Outside of the ill-fated Andromeda follow-up that launched in 2017, players were able to carry major choices from each entry over to the next, resulting in a trilogy of games with a highly personalized story.
paragraphs.cn: 《质量效应》粉丝都知道贯穿整个系列的主线剧情有多重要，尤其是指挥官谢泼德在前三部作品中对抗收割者的故事。除了2017年发售、命运多舛的《质量效应：仙女座》外，玩家在前作中做出的重大选择都能延续到下一部作品中，让这三部曲拥有高度个性化的剧情。

paragraphs.en: Relationships, major character deaths, and even the fate of an entire species are just a few of the ways Shepard can be steered to shape the galaxy, and although whether it was all worth it in the end is still up for debate, it seems Mass Effect: Universe would have offered an opportunity to right some wrongs . Toutain said they had plans for those who just prefer to experiment with the story and its many, many branches, too. He likened the freedom to "generate timelines" to Spike Chunsoft's 2016 video game, Zero Time Dilemma .
paragraphs.cn: 玩家可以通过影响人际关系、决定重要角色的生死，甚至左右整个物种的命运，引导谢泼德塑造银河系。最终这一切是否值得，仍有争议；但《质量效应：宇宙》似乎也会给玩家机会弥补一些遗憾。Toutain还说，开发团队也为那些只想尝试剧情及其众多分支的玩家准备了方案。他将「生成时间线」的自由度比作Spike Chunsoft于2016年推出的游戏《极限脱出：零时困境》。

paragraphs.en: "You have no f**king idea just how great it was," he continued. Then, responding to a fan asking whether Mass Effect: Universe would have featured systems similar to what was found in Dragon Age: Inquisition and the series' lore-tailoring Keep application, he said, "kinda, yeah."
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「你们根本想象不到它有多棒。」有粉丝问《质量效应：宇宙》是否会采用类似《龙腾世纪：审判》的系统，以及系列设定定制工具Keep的功能。Toutain回答：「差不多吧，是的。」

paragraphs.en: "It's more like, you can make decisions that might contradict things you've already done or thing you have to do, and so it would create plot 'points' in the timeline. I mean, that was the theory. It worked, in practice. I'll tell you about the tech one day because it was really exciting.
paragraphs.cn: 「更像是，你可以做出与之前做过的事，或必须要做的事相矛盾的决定，这样就会在时间线上产生剧情‘节点’。这只是理论上的说法，但实际上确实能运作。总有一天我会告诉你们背后的技术，因为它真的很令人兴奋。」

paragraphs.en: "We got worked up, f**k. Everything in the game. Everything was stateful, and at any time, you could stop the game – I mean you could pause it – and ask a system that solved logical equations, 'Is this valid?' And if it isn't valid, what conditions must be met for it to be valid?"
paragraphs.cn: 「我们当时简直激动坏了，操。游戏里的一切，一切都有状态。你随时可以停下游戏——我是说暂停——然后问一个负责求解逻辑方程的系统：‘这样成立吗？’如果不成立，要满足什么条件才能成立？」

paragraphs.en: The ideas Toutain teased sound ambitious and complex, and unfortunately, they will likely never see the light of day. EA announced last week that it had shuttered the long-running RPG developer and canceled what would likely have been called Mass Effect: Universe , with additional plans for the franchise's future in games on hold, too. Fans have already erected a #SaveMassEffect movement in the aftermath, with a petition garnering an unreal 185,000 signatures at the time of this story's publication.
paragraphs.cn: Toutain透露的构想听起来既宏大又复杂，但遗憾的是，它们可能永远不会面世。EA上周宣布关闭这家老牌RPG开发工作室，并取消了这款很可能名为《质量效应：宇宙》的游戏；系列后续游戏的其他规划也暂时搁置。消息传出后，粉丝发起了#SaveMassEffect运动；截至本文发布时，相关请愿已获得惊人的185,000个签名。

paragraphs.en: Other highlights from Toutain's stream include the revelation that the Reaper-like hand featured in recently leaked footage was named Billy, as well as the idea that the developers were hoping to craft a story that gave each player a completely unique experience. More information about what Mass Effect 5 would have been have also leaked in the days after BioWare's demise. Those details include a full trailer , as well as gameplay details that promised missions with "Hitman-style freedom." The Prime Video show, meanwhile, is said to still be in the works .
paragraphs.cn: Toutain在直播中还透露，近期泄露影像里那只形似收割者的手名叫Billy；开发团队希望打造一段能让每位玩家都获得截然不同体验的故事。BioWare关闭后的几天里，《质量效应5》的更多信息也相继泄露，包括一支完整预告片，以及有关玩法的细节：任务将提供「《杀手》式的自由度」。与此同时，据称Prime Video剧集仍在制作中。
